title: a11y: 25 icon-only buttons have no accessible name and 24 clickable div/span elements have no role or keyboard handler; axe runs in 6 of 4,004 DOM tests and 0 e2e specs
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction). Also filing gate ①: reach: the controls named below are rendered in the console shell (AppHeader, ChatDock, AiChatPage, InvitationsPage, ApprovalsInboxPage, MarketplaceRowActions) and are unreachable or unnamed for screen-reader and keyboard users.

## 维护者速读

82 个图标按钮里 **25 个没有可访问名称**（app-shell 11、components 9、fields 3、chatbot 2）；**24 个 `div/span onClick`** 没有 role / tabIndex / 键盘处理（app-shell 17）。`img` 的 alt 23/23 健康。没有 jsx-a11y lint；`vitest-axe` 只在 6/4,004 个 DOM 测试里，34 个 e2e spec 里 0 次 axe。objectui#12143 关闭时明确把「图标按钮普查」留成一个独立家族，但没人立。建议用 `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145` 同形的只减不增 ratchet 处理，不上全仓 jsx-a11y。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; script `a11y.mjs` in the review scratchpad)

- Icon-only `Button` elements with `size="icon"`: 82; 57 carry `aria-label`, `title` or sr-only text; **25 do not** — e.g. `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/InvitationsPage.tsx` (two), `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx` (two).
- `div` or `span` with `onClick` and no `role`, `tabIndex` or key handler: **24** — e.g. `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (two), `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceRowActions.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/OrganizationsPage.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx`.
- `img` without `alt`: 0 of 23 (positive control: 23 `img` found). `tabIndex={-1}` 12, `autoFocus` 35. `role="alert"` 68 and `aria-live` 18 against 372 `text-destructive` error-text sites (announcement gap, tracked with the error-state card).
- Lint: no a11y plugin in `eslint.config.js` (positive control: 11 custom `object-ui/*` rules registered). Tests: `vitest-axe` / `axe-core` in 6 test files of 4,004 `.test.tsx`; e2e: 0 axe runs in 34 specs.
- Focus management is healthy: the radix focus-scope patch is documented with a regression test.
- Business reason: a keyboard or screen-reader user in the console cannot name or reach these 49 controls; NORTH-STAR "看着不对与渲染不出同样是缺陷".
- Dedup (`icon-only|aria-label|clickable div|role="button"`): 81 hits, 0 open; the nearest closed are objectui#12143 (left the icon-only census as a separate family), #12510, #12529, #12145, #13334, #11690.

## Task

- [ ] A ratchet census test for unnamed icon-only buttons in the ordinary suite, same shape as `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145` (allowlist = today's 25, deletions only), then burn the list down.
- [ ] Replace the 24 clickable div/span with `button` elements (or `role="button"` plus `onKeyDown`).
- [ ] 未实测 and optional: one per-route axe pass in `e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts` with `@axe-core/playwright` to learn the real violation count; do not add `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` repo-wide before the two items above land.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat. Effort S for the first two items.
